text: {style} {detail} Turn this photo into such a coloring page. Draw every person (and pet) in the photo, up to four, with whole bodies and a clear white margin around them: nothing cut off at the edges. Keep their poses, hairstyles and the shapes of their clothes so they are recognizable, but draw clothes as plain shapes with no knit, stripes or patterns. Faces are simple and friendly: eyes, nose and a smile, never left blank. Keep one or two big objects they hold or sit at (a cake, a balloon, a basket). Leave out the rest of the background. If there are no people, draw the main objects instead.

text: Make a black-and-white coloring-book line drawing traced from this photo. Use only clean, thick, even black outlines around each main shape; every area inside the outlines is plain white. Remove all shading, shadows, textures, patterns and the background. Close every outline so each area can be filled with one crayon color. Keep the subject's pose and proportions true to the photo. {detail} Landscape 4:3, no text, no border.
